Risk Description: Training data encodes historical hiring discrimination against women in technical roles
Mitigation Control: Conduct regular bias audits using disaggregated metrics across protected characteristics; retrain model on balanced datasets; implement disparate impact testing before deployment.

Risk Description: Candidates cannot understand why they were rejected; the scoring algorithm is not explainable
Mitigation Control: Provide candidates with a clear explanation of how their application was assessed per Article 86 (Right to Explanation); publish summary information about the system's logic.

Risk Description: Processes sensitive personal data without adequate data minimization
Mitigation Control: Implement data minimization; process only information directly relevant to job requirements; conduct GDPR Data Protection Impact Assessment alongside this AIIA.

Risk Description: System may not generalize across job types or candidate populations
Mitigation Control: Conduct regular performance evaluations across job types and demographic groups; establish minimum accuracy thresholds.

Risk Description: Incorrect rejections at scale systematically exclude qualified candidates
Mitigation Control: Implement human review override for all rejections above a volume threshold; establish appeals process for candidates.
